title: Refuse or name memory keys a task-sync export still publishes after removing the task they retire with
outcome: Refuse or name memory keys a task-sync export still publishes after removing the task they retire with
acceptance: An export that removes task T from the exchange while the committed memory component holds a key that retires with T either refuses, naming the key, T and a remedy, or no longer publishes the key without its target, so that a fresh receiving host never meets memory_retiring_target_missing for it. A CLI behaviour test proves it.
